if the Lagna pada and Dara pada are mutually angular or 3rd and 11th or trinal, the native will be a king ruling the earth.

chunk_text: similar deductions be made with reference to mutual positions of Lagna pada and Dhana pada.

O Brahmin, now I tell you about Upa pada, the auspiciousness of which will confer on the native happiness from progeny, wife etc. Upa pada is calculated for the bhava following the natal ascendant. This Upa Pada is also called Gaunapada.
The pada of Lagna (i.e. Arudha Lagna) explained earlier is (of course) of prime importance.
